notes.notes:
Changelog:


 Fixed auto-farming
 Children should not be born outside the house
 Labourers got stuck on construction site - fixed
 Build icon was misaligned - fixed

notes.title: Colonize Prologue Update #4
notes.notes:
Hello colonizer!

Changes:


 Auto Harvest! No need to click on the Harvest button
 Crops grow slower
 Farm is no longer called Wheat Field
 No longer spending money on livestock when the farm is full
 Farm is closing by temperature - 7°C closes 15°C opens
 No F word anymore
 Fixed Icons position, was wrong since the last update



If you are not happy with the changes, go to Discord and tell us more what you wish for!

notes.title: Colonize Prologue update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Colonizers!

A lot of bug fixes and changes!


 Hapinness average of 45 to born children
 Fixed speed 3 glitch - temporarily slowed down - we need to rework that from scratch
 Added animations of harvesting/gathering meat
 Added blue/red circles of positive and negative happiness in the buildings
 Fixed incorrect gathering of Input resources
 Zoom out is further
 Fixed farm fields!
 Health is more dynamic
 Health is more stable -  to the age +-45


Known issues:

The problem with settings to low can change the resolution settings and causes problems with GUI - working on fixing this one! 

Have a nice day!

 children are born inside the house

notes.title: Colonize Prologue - first release
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Colonizer!

We are excited to share our years of effort with you, it's a start of a new journey and creating a community so we can build and improve this game together.

Even if it is released, it's not finished, we are aware of this one. So we are begging you to be patient with all the bugs you will encounter. Colonize Prologue is our intro to PC game development, STEAM, and overall creating a community. 

Rembrosoft is mainly two guys, two brothers, we cannot compete with big studios and we are aware of that, but trying to make this experience the best as possible. 

So what now? Please write us all bugs/suggestions or ideas on our Discord Server - https://discord.com/invite/uUEbeKjBNJ

That's all guys! Hope you will have fun!
